name: dream-num/univer
title: dream-num/univer
headline: Univer keeps attracting AI office builders
lede: Univer is still drawing attention for embedding office editing, calculation, collaboration and file processing for people and agents, with 1,878 stars recorded for the day.

effects.effect: Makes office functions available inside agent-facing products
Agents get an embeddable office surface to act on

possibilities.title: Planners can fix hard statement layouts by having agents read page images

with.title: Qwen4-Max combines vision with million-token context

possibilities.connection: On 2026-11-15 Magpie suggested financial planners turn client statement PDFs into agent-maintained Univer spreadsheets through a document converter; today Qwen4-Max adds native vision with a 1 million token context, so layouts that break text conversion can be read from page images and cross-checked before values land in Univer.

possibilities.title: Financial planners can turn client statement PDFs into live, agent-maintained spreadsheets

with.title: Convert PDFs and Office files to LLM-ready text
Financial planners without coding build their own agents

possibilities.connection: The converter turns PDFs and Office files into markdown or JSON, Univer lets agents and people edit and calculate in the same sheet, and the planners' guide shows non-coders building their own agents and skills.
